digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and blocking thresholds
propositions: correctness and edge-cases dimensions lack explicit routing entries in criteria_routing.json and resolve through the unknown-criterion default (0.95 threshold, non-blocking)
measured block-impact at 0.54 threshold shows correctness affecting 4.04% of changes and edge-cases affecting 1.74%, both within the 8.0% operator-accepted friction budget
concurrency is routed as advisory but remains below the MIN_N=25 calibration floor with 0.0% impact, so routing state should not change
the replay blocking set is hard-coded in replay_code_v4_would_block.py and would desynchronize from the packaged posture if routing changes without manual update
adding correctness and edge-cases to canonical vocabulary via routing_index() expansion affects registry.effective_criteria() and downstream consumers
